insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: ₹1,00,000 to ₹25,00,000 (as per tables in wording; selected SI not specified in provided pages)

great.name: PED waiting period (12 months)
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with insurer
great.reference: Section 3 EXCLUSIONS > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01
great.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 12 months of continuous coverage, which is better than many policies.

great.name: AYUSH inpatient hospitalization covered up to Sum Insured
great.quote: AYUSH Treatment: Medical expenses for Inpatient Hospitalization incurred on treatment under Ayurveda, Unani, Sidha and Homeopathy systems of medicines in a AYUSH Hospital is payable up to the sum insured.
great.explanation: Covers AYUSH inpatient hospitalization expenses up to the base Sum Insured (Yoga/Naturopathy needs prior approval as per note).

good.name: Initial waiting period (30 days; accidents covered immediately)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Section 3 EXCLUSIONS > 3. 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illnesses; accident claims are not subject to this waiting.

good.name: Specified disease/procedure waiting period (24 months)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of following listed Conditions, surgeries/ treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Section 3 EXCLUSIONS > 2. Speciﬁed disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02
good.explanation: Standard 24-month waiting for listed specific diseases/procedures.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover (30 days)
good.quote: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses incurred for a period not exceeding 30 days prior to the date of hospitalisation
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 30 days before hospitalization for the same condition.

good.name: Day care procedures covered
good.quote: All day care procedures are covered under this policy
good.explanation: Day care treatments are covered even without 24-hour hospitalization.

bad.name: Room rent limit / capping (daily caps by Sum Insured)
bad.quote:
Sum Insured Room Rent Limit (per day)
Rs.1,00,000/- to Rs.5,00,000/- Up to 1% of the sum insured.
Rs.7,50,000/- and Rs.10,00,000/- Up to Rs.6,000/-
Rs.15,00,000/- Up to Rs.7,000/-
Rs.20,00,000/- Up to Rs.8,500/-
Rs.25,00,000/- Up to Rs.10,000/-
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped (percentage or fixed ₹ limit). This can restrict hospital choice and can trigger proportionate deductions.

bad.name: Proportionate deduction linked to room rent eligibility
bad.quote: If Policy Holder chooses a higher room category above the eligibility deﬁned in policy, then proportionate deduction will apply on the Associated Medical Expenses in addition to the difference in room rent.
bad.reference: Section 1 DEFINITIONS > SPECIFIC DEFINITIONS > Associated medical expenses
bad.explanation: If you take a room above eligibility, the insurer can proportionately reduce associated medical expenses (not just charge room rent difference).

bad.name: Mandatory co-payment (30% on all claims)
bad.quote: Co-payment: This policy is subject to co-payment of 30% for all claims.
bad.explanation: You must pay 30% of every admissible claim amount, which significantly reduces effective coverage.

bad.name: Disease-wise / condition-wise sub-limits (major conditions) per policy period
bad.quote: The expenses payable during the entire policy period for treatment of the following diseases / conditions ... is limited to the amount mentioned in table below;
bad.explanation: Imposes sub-limits for specific diseases/conditions (e.g., cataract, cardio/cerebrovascular, cancer, renal diseases, fractures, major surgeries), which can be much lower than the Sum Insured.

bad.name: Modern treatments covered but with low sub-limits
bad.quote: Coverage for Modern Treatments: The expenses payable during the entire policy period for the following treatment / procedure ... is limited to the amount mentioned in table below;
bad.explanation: Modern treatments are not covered at actuals; they are restricted to sub-limits, which may be insufficient for high-cost procedures.

unclear.name: No Claim Bonus / renewal bonus (not found in provided pages)
unclear.quote: Not mentioned in the provided extract/pages.
unclear.explanation: NCB/renewal bonus terms are not visible in the shared pages. Verify if any cumulative bonus/additional sum insured is offered and whether it resets on a claim.
